reason: I've already talked to a company and I'm about to decide, so I'm not going to start collecting new offers now and wait two more days. My shop loses money every power cut and I want this done.
objection: Once a few companies have my request they'll keep calling the shop phone, and I don't know who you are any more than I know them. My neighbour's system had problems even with a known installer, so a website promising to check things doesn't make me feel much safer.
would_change_my_mind: If I could send the one quote I already have and get it checked the same day, without my number going to any company, I might do that before I sign.
